chinese: 和大怨，必有余怨，安可以为善？
是以圣人执左契，而不责于人。
pinyin: Hé dà yuàn， bì yǒu yú yuàn， ān kě yǐ wèi shàn？
Shì yǐ shèng rén zhí zuǒ qì， ér bù zé yú rén。
Yǒu dé sī qì， wú dé sī chè。
Tiān dào wú qīn， cháng yǔ shàn rén。
english: Difficulties remain, even after solving a problem. How then can we consider that as good?
Therefore the Master does what she knows is right, and makes no demands of others. A virtuous person will do the right thing, and persons with no virtue will take advantage of others.
The Tao does not choose sides, the good person receives from the Tao because she is on its side.
